annotations.title: Get the status of a build

description: Use this when the person asks how a Pugi build or change is going, or for a fresh preview link. In hosts that render the build card (MCP Apps or ChatGPT widget) the card tracks progress; in hosts without one (Claude Code or API) job_status reports it until the job is finished, stopped or failed. Preview links expire after 15 minutes; a new call returns a fresh link.

job_id.description: The job_id build_site, build_app or edit returned.
